resources.name: entries
resources.description: One row per catalogued field: where it lives in an APB result and what it means.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: entry_id
fields.description: Where the field lives, as six fields separated by /: <source>/<version>/<level>/<attribute>/<key>/<column>. Read apb-fasta/*/peptidoform_ion/varm/fasta_validation/is_proteotypic as: apb-fasta writes it, for every software version, on the peptidoform_ion level, in varm, in the table fasta_validation, column is_proteotypic. source: the conversion software, an app named in producers, or annotation:<convention>. version: one versions.csv label, or * for every version. level: the quantification level, or * for every level, which only annotation and app entries use. attribute: obs, var, layers or varm. key: the name of a layer or varm table; - for obs and var, which have none. column: a column of obs, var or a varm table; - for a layer, which has none; a trailing * matches every obs column starting with it, as in annotation:sdrf/*/protein/obs/-/factor_value_*.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What the field measures; a value of the set's kind qualifier.

fields.name: basis
fields.description: Why the reviewer assigned this meaning.

fields.name: evidence_url
fields.description: Where the basis can be checked; may be empty.

resources.name: entry_qualifiers
resources.description: The qualifiers of each entry besides its kind.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: entry_id
fields.description: The entry qualified.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The qualified entry's kind; with entry_id it names one entry.

fields.name: qualifier
fields.description: A qualifier of the set's vocabulary.

fields.name: value
fields.description: One of the qualifier's values.

resources.name: vocabulary
resources.description: Each set, its qualifiers and their values, with their definitions. A set's row has an empty qualifier; a qualifier's row has an empty value.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: qualifier
fields.description: The qualifier defined; empty on the set's row.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The value defined; empty on the set's and the qualifiers' rows.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: What the set, qualifier or value means.

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: The set's row only: what the set is for.

fields.name: used_by
fields.description: The set's row only: who uses the set, separated by ';'.

resources.name: keys
resources.description: The access keys of each set, one meaning each: the kind and the qualifier values a key stands for. An entry has the key whose kind and fixed values it carries.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The name callers ask by.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The kind the key stands for.

fields.name: normalization
fields.description: The normalization the key stands for; empty when the key leaves it open.

fields.name: stage
fields.description: The stage the key stands for; empty when the key leaves it open.

fields.name: psi_ms
fields.description: PSI-MS terms for the key's meaning, separated by ';'; may be empty.

resources.name: requirements
resources.description: How strongly a set's consumer needs one key on one level and location.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: level
fields.description: The quantification level.

fields.name: location
fields.description: obs, layers, var or varm.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The key required.

fields.name: requirement
fields.description: MUST, SHOULD or MAY.

resources.name: producers
resources.description: Apps that write fields after conversion, such as apb-fasta, and the run that must record them before their fields exist.

fields.name: set
fields.description: The catalogue set.

fields.name: producer
fields.description: The app, as named in entries' source.

fields.name: requires
fields.description: The result metadata path, joined by '.', that records the app's run.

fields.name: instruction
fields.description: What to run before the app's fields exist.

resources.name: versions
resources.description: The software versions APB2 has a rule for, written from APB2's packaged rules when the catalog is written: each version's label, which entries name, and the rule's version pattern, which a converted result stores. A version's levels are the levels its entries name.

fields.name: software
fields.description: The software name APB2's rule declares.

fields.name: version
fields.description: The version range's label, as entries name it.

fields.name: software_version_pattern
fields.description: The rule's software version pattern, as a converted result stores it.
